      theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.polynomial_of_block_expansion {k : Type u_1} [Field k] {a : Type u_3} {m : Type u_4} {n : Type u_5} {t : Type u_6} [Fintype a] [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [Fintype t] [IsAlgClosed k] (D : a → Matrix m n k) (hD : ∀ (r s : ℕ), HasMatrixSubspacePair D r s → 0 < r → (r < Fintype.card n → r < s) ∧ (r = Fintype.card n → r ≤ s)) (ht : Fintype.card n ^ 2 < Fintype.card t) :
      ∃ (p : MvPolynomial (t × a × t) k), p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ (x : t × a × t → k), (MvPolynomial.eval x) p ≠ 0 → Function.Injective (blockFamily D x).mulVec

      Over an algebraically closed field, a rectangular family strictly expanding proper nonzero subspaces has an injective blowup on a nonempty principal open set at every size greater than the square of its source dimension.
